Vendored for local/offline rendering. No runtime CDN. Each library's MIT license is included alongside.

- Cytoscape.js 3.34.3 — https://registry.npmjs.org/cytoscape/-/cytoscape-3.34.3.tgz
- cytoscape-fcose 2.2.0 — https://registry.npmjs.org/cytoscape-fcose/-/cytoscape-fcose-2.2.0.tgz (force-directed layout)
- cose-base 2.2.0 — https://registry.npmjs.org/cose-base/-/cose-base-2.2.0.tgz (fcose dependency)
- layout-base 2.0.1 — https://registry.npmjs.org/layout-base/-/layout-base-2.0.1.tgz (cose-base dependency)

Load order in index.html: cytoscape.min.js, layout-base.js, cose-base.js, cytoscape-fcose.js.
